mutations.label: judge: Context must cite something observable
mutations.only: ^(?:E1 fires when the Context is preference rather than observation)$

mutations.label: judge: an alternative names why it lost
mutations.only: ^(?:E2 fires on an alternative that is only a name|an alternative whose reason wraps is read whole, not judged on its first line)$

mutations.label: judge: a comparative claim carries evidence in its own section
mutations.only: ^(?:E3 fires on a comparative claim with nothing behind it)$

mutations.label: judge: the Decision commits
mutations.from: if decision.strip() and HEDGE.search(decision) and not COMMITMENT.search(decision):
mutations.only: ^(?:C1 fires on a Decision that never commits)$

mutations.label: judge: an authoring marker is not a template placeholder
mutations.only: ^(?:every adr-judge rule has a case that makes it fire, and a record that passes them all|C2 fires on an authoring marker, and only on a real one)$

mutations.label: judge: Consequences state a cost
mutations.only: ^(?:C3 fires when every consequence is upside)$

mutations.label: judge: prose judgement never blocks
mutations.only: ^(?:E1 fires when the Context is preference rather than observation|E2 fires on an alternative that is only a name|E3 fires on a comparative claim with nothing behind it|C1 fires on a Decision that never commits|C2 fires on an authoring marker, and only on a real one|C3 fires when every consequence is upside|an alternative whose reason wraps is read whole, not judged on its first line)$

mutations.label: judge: a Context may cite a ticket, version, standard or commit
mutations.only: ^(?:E1 accepts every ordinary way a Context cites something checkable)$

mutations.label: judge: prose alternatives are judged too
mutations.only: ^(?:E2 fires on an alternative that is only a name)$

mutations.label: judge: a bare name has no clause after a separator
mutations.only: ^(?:E2 fires on an alternative that is only a name)$

mutations.label: judge: a marker inside a fence is not this record's
mutations.only: ^(?:C2 fires on an authoring marker, and only on a real one)$

mutations.label: judge: a cost may be worded any way a record words it
mutations.only: ^(?:C3 accepts Consequences that state a cost, however it is worded)$

mutations.label: judge: a wrapped alternative is read whole
mutations.only: ^(?:an alternative whose reason wraps is read whole, not judged on its first line)$

mutations.label: judge: a blank line ends a bullet
mutations.from: elif not line.strip() or not CONTINUATION.match(line):
mutations.only: ^(?:an alternative whose reason wraps is read whole, not judged on its first line)$

mutations.label: adr-judge: a rule whose section is absent is named, not counted as a pass
mutations.only: ^(?:a rule with nothing to judge is named, not counted as a pass)$

mutations.label: adr-judge: a record with a vacuous rule does not report all pass
mutations.from: headline = (f" — evidence and clarity rules pass; {len(empty)} rule(s) had nothing to judge")
mutations.to: headline = " — evidence and clarity rules all pass"
mutations.only: ^(?:a rule with nothing to judge is named, not counted as a pass)$
